welcomeText: Your subscription is active. Here’s what’s left before your first sale.
progressText: A few steps left before your first sale.

setup.title: Get your shop ready to sell
setup.text: Do these in any order. Optional ones won’t block you.

branch.title: Create the first branch
branch.text: Where you sell. Receipts use its details.

terminal.title: Add a checkout terminal
terminal.text: Name the counter your cashiers sell from.

catalog.title: Prepare categories, units and tax rates

products.title: Add products
products.text: Names, prices and how you identify them.

stock.title: Add opening stock
stock.text: Count what is on your shelves today.

payments.title: Configure payment methods
payments.text: Cash, card, wallet — how customers pay you.

employees.title: Invite employees
employees.text: Cashiers and staff get their own sign-in.

shift.title: Open a shift and start selling
shift.text: Count the drawer, then ring up the first sale.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.text: Branches, products and cashiers are limited by your plan.

help.title: Need a hand?
help.text: Each step opens the right screen and brings you back here when you’re done.

cashier.text: You can sell and look up customers. Ask your manager if you need anything else.
cashier.openShift: Open your shift on {{terminal}} at {{branch}} to start selling.
cashier.openShiftPlain: Open your shift to start selling.
